Game Overview

Shadow Shifter is a runner title where unleash your inner ninja in Shadow Shifter, where cunning and agility are your allies. Transform into an inconspicuous box, navigate complex parkour levels, and face formidable bosses. With seamless controls and escalating challenges, experience the thrill of stealth and surprise in your quest for mastery.
